name: Unnecessary If
hint: You are using two [sbi]if < > then[/sbi] blocks after another with the same combination of blocks inside.
instruction: You can make that easier to read by using an [sbi]<< > or < >>[/sbi] block combining the conditions in a single [sbi]if < > then[/sbi] block.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <touching color (#f00) ?> then
move (2) steps
end
if <touching color (#0f0) ?> then :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
move (2) steps
end
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <<touching color (#f00) ?> or <touching color (#0f0) ?>> then :: #007000 //⇦  👍
move (2) steps
end
